name: Timeee
subtitle: Clock radio, alarms and sleep
description: Timeee: a vintage clock radio for your iPhone. Alarms with smart snooze, sleep tracking, world radio, sleep sounds. Everything stays on your iPhone: no account, no analytics, no tracking.

apps.name: Timeee
apps.subtitle: Clock radio, alarms and sleep
apps.localizedDescription:
A clock radio in the spirit of 60s Braun radios, in French and English.

• Alarms that ring even on silent, with a bounded snooze (9, 7 then 5 min, louder each time)
• Wake up to the weather, music or world radio
• Challenges to stop the alarm: math, shake, memory
• Sleep: Health nights (Apple Watch or iPhone), sleep debt, trends, journal
• Night mode, night recordings, sleep sounds mixer, bedtime reminder
• Nap dial, timer, stopwatch, world clock, StandBy widgets, Dynamic Island

Privacy: no account, no analytics, no ads, no tracking. Alarms, nights, journal and recordings never leave your iPhone. Weather receives your location rounded to about 1 km; radio search goes to Radio Browser.

Requires iOS 26.2 or later.

privacy.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Timeee schedules your alarms so they ring even in silent mode.
privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Timeee reads your playlists to wake you up with music when the app is open.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Timeee reads your nights from Health to show your sleep time, stages and sleep debt.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Timeee uses your location while the app is open, to show your city's weather when the alarm rings.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Timeee records night sounds (snoring, talking) when you turn it on in Night mode. Nothing leaves your iPhone.
